name: sys2qa-monorepo
description: Sys2QA — evidence-based system analysis (SAA) and quality assurance (QAA) platform

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tests/e2e/tsconfig.json
scripts.trace: vitest run --reporter=default --reporter=json --outputFile.json=reports/test-results.json && vitest run --config vitest.e2e.config.ts --reporter=default --reporter=json --outputFile.json=reports/e2e-results.json && node scripts/traceability.mjs --results reports/test-results.json,reports/e2e-results.json
scripts.sys2qa: node scripts/build-adapters.mjs && node scripts/build-web.mjs && node --conditions=source --import tsx apps/cli/src/bin.ts
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm schemas:check && pnpm fixtures:check && pnpm deps:check && pnpm trace:check && pnpm docs:links && pnpm test
